citation.short_title: Melvin-Koushki, The New Brethren of Purity (2025)

content: The paper describes Ibn Turka's vision of philosopher-kingship as a composite of his three Timurid patrons, Iskandar, Ulugh Beg and Bāysunghur, and says the Debate of Feast and Fight was meant to instruct his Timurid royal patron in the role of Emperor Love.
